readme: Reviewed exceptions to the dependency advisory gate. See security/README.md before editing. Checked by scripts/audit-gate.mjs.

exceptions.rationale: image-size is Metro's asset-dimension reader: it parses image headers while the bundler resolves assets, and behind the dev-server asset endpoint under `expo start`. It reaches the production graph only because Metro is a transitive dependency of react-native and expo — no Metro code is in a release bundle, which carries the computed dimensions rather than the parser. The images it parses are the assets committed to this repository; the dev-server path exists on a developer machine only and is not present in any shipped build. image-size@1.2.1 is the latest release and no patched version exists, so this cannot be closed with an `overrides` entry.

Same package and same reachability as GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq: Metro's bundle-time and dev-server image-header parser, reachable through react-native and expo but absent from every release bundle, and fed only by assets committed to this repository. image-size@1.2.1 is the latest release and no patched version exists, so this cannot be closed with an `overrides` entry.
